batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2015-2016, Set-3 — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading (with zoomed crops) of Part 2 of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.208-215 (printed pp.23-30 of Part 2). The paper header on book PDF p.208 was confirmed visually before transcription: জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৫-২০১৬ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান ৮০, ইউনিট-A, সেট-3, সময় ১:০০ ঘণ্টা, under the banner «প্রশ্ন-সমাধান: ২০১৫-১৬». The previous paper (A 2015-2016 Set-5) ends on book PDF p.207 and the next paper (D 2016-2017 Set-1) begins on book PDF p.216; this paper's Q80 (cow's-milk water percentage) is the last item on p.215 and nothing from p.216 onward is included. Part 2 has NO answer table: each key is inline — an '[Ans: x]' tag and/or a printed worked solution 'সমাধান: (x)' / 'Solution: (x)'. Key forms in this paper: 24 questions are keyed by the [Ans: ] tag alone (Q1-11, 61-63, 67, 69-71, 73, 75, 76, 78-80), 55 by their printed worked solutions, and 1 (Q54) carries the printed no-correct-option disposition 'সমাধান: (সঠিক উত্তর নেই)'; no question carries both a tag and a solution, there are no dual keys and no keyless questions. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are unverified (single-source transcription) — content status 'unverified' throughout and every keyed answer answer-'unverified'; the single disposition question carries answer status 'verified' only because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition, encoding the book's own printed claim and nothing more. The book prints no per-subject headings in this paper; subject blocks follow the printed question-number ranges, confirmed by content: General Knowledge Q1-8, Bangla Q9-11, English Q12-14, Physics Q15-36, Higher Mathematics Q37-58, Chemistry Q59-80 — counts General Knowledge 8, Bangla 3, English 3, Physics 22, Higher Mathematics 22, Chemistry 22. TIER STRUCTURE (each question's tier is recorded in its topic field): the 'Short Syllabus' banner stands on p.208 and its main run (pp.208-214) holds 66 questions (Q1-20, 22, 24, 26-41, 43-45, 48-52, 54-56, 60-68, 72-79); the 'Extra Syllabus' heading stands at the foot of p.214 and its section (pp.214-215) holds the remaining 14 questions (Physics Q21, 23, 25; Higher Mathematics Q42, 46, 47, 53, 57, 58; Chemistry Q59, 69-71, 80). No 'Old Syllabus' section occurs in this paper. Within every subject the tiers partition the printed numbers exactly once: Physics Short 19 + Extra 3 = 22; Higher Mathematics Short 16 + Extra 6 = 22; Chemistry Short 17 + Extra 5 = 22; General Knowledge, Bangla and English are entirely Short Syllabus. Nine solutions explicitly key the printed 'কোনটিই নয়' (none) option — Physics Q15, Q20, Q22, Q30, Q36 and Chemistry Q65, Q68, Q74, Q77 — and each is an ordinary single key to that option, not a disposition. Preserved print anomalies: Q38's printed matrices can never be equal and the book's own solution says so, keying (a) for a corrected reading; Q36's solution computes 18000 Å yet adds that the correct answer should really have been zero, while still keying (d); Q54's solution computes the focus (4, 2), absent from the options, under the printed heading 'সঠিক উত্তর নেই'; Q49(d) prints the denominator (1+2x)^-2; Q51(c) prints '-∞'; Q66's stem opens 'কোন মিশ্রণে' as printed; Q68's options print no units; Q9(a) prints 'তৎপুরুষ' without the 'সমাস' suffix of options (b)-(d); Q45(c) and Q53(b) themselves print ± values under single keys; Q59 is a general-knowledge-flavoured question (cyclone sea temperature) printed inside the Chemistry block and assigned to Chemistry by block position. No question stem or option set carries a figure; diagrams appear only inside printed worked solutions (Q16's force diagram, Q51's Argand diagram, Q56's right triangle). [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. Part 2 pagination: printed book page = book PDF page − 185. Set-3 of JU A Unit 2015-2016 occupies book PDF pp.208-215 (printed book pp.23-30): 'Short Syllabus' banner and Q1-14 on p.208 (printed p.23); the main Short run continues over pp.209-214; the 'Extra Syllabus' heading stands at the foot of p.214 (printed p.29) above Q21, and the Extra section continues on p.215 (printed p.30), ending with the paper's last question, Q80. Part 2 prints no answer table ('উত্তরমালা'); keys are inline '[Ans: x]' tags or printed worked solutions. Paper header (book PDF p.208) confirmed visually before transcription: জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৫-২০১৬ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান: ৮০, ইউনিট: A, সেট: 3, সময়: ১:০০ ঘণ্টা, banner «প্রশ্ন-সমাধান: ২০১৫-১৬»; no further printed instructions (no negative-marking or calculator statement) appear on the paper's first page. The previous paper (JU A Unit 2015-2016 Set-5) ends on book PDF p.207 and the next paper (JU D Unit 2016-2017 Set-1) begins on book PDF p.216. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page image, with zoomed re-reads (PIL crops at 200%) for Q36-Q39, Q43-Q44, Q49-Q51 and Q66-Q68. Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π, matrices wrapped in [...] with rows separated by ';', unit vectors as î, ĵ, k̂ and vector arrows as →; chemical formulas written with plain digits for subscripts, e.g. N2O4, CaCO3; binary/octal base subscripts as _2/_8 and combination notation in plain form, e.g. nC4).
